privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro1: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacyPolicy.intro2: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have regarding your personal data.
privacyPolicy.intro3: When processing data, we comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable national laws.
privacyPolicy.intro4: Please read this document carefully. By continuing to use the site, you confirm that you have read and agree to its terms.

dataCollection.title: What data we collect
dataCollection.text: We only collect information that is necessary to deliver our services and communicate with you:
dataCollection.item1: Contact details: name, email address, phone number, country of residence.
dataCollection.item2: Medical information: details about health status and requests that you voluntarily provide during consultations.
dataCollection.text2: We never collect medical data without your explicit consent and never use it outside the scope of concierge services.

howWeCollect.title: How we collect data
howWeCollect.text1: Data reaches us directly from you — through site forms, email correspondence, messengers, and phone conversations.
howWeCollect.text2: We may also receive technical information (IP address, device and browser type, visited pages). This data is used solely to analyse site performance.

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.text: We process personal data for the following purposes:
purpose.item1: Responding to your inquiries and supporting you within concierge services.
purpose.item2: Coordinating treatment, document translation and communication with clinics.
purpose.item3: Arranging travel and logistics during your stay in Germany.
purpose.item4: Improving the quality of our services and website.
purpose.item5: Complying with legal obligations and protecting our rights.
purpose.legal3: Our legitimate interests in developing and protecting the service (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR).

sharing.title: Sharing with third parties
sharing.text1: We do not sell your data and do not share it with third parties unnecessarily.
sharing.text2: Data may be shared with clinics, physicians and translators only to the extent necessary to deliver services, and with your consent.
sharing.text3: We may engage trusted contractors for IT support and hosting. They are bound by the same data protection standards.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectify, erase your data, restrict or object to processing, and to data portability. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at contact@gmed-health.com.

hosting.title: Website hosting
hosting.text1: The site is hosted by a certified provider within the European Union.
hosting.text2: When you visit the site, the server automatically logs technical data for security and stability.
hosting.text3: This data is retained for a limited period and is not used to identify users.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text1: We use cookies to ensure the site works correctly, analyse traffic and improve the user experience.
cookies.text2: You can disable cookies at any time in your browser settings — this will not affect access to the core content of the site.

storage.title: Data storage
storage.text1: We store your data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected.
storage.text2: After this period, data is deleted or anonymised unless otherwise required by law.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.text: Contact and medical information is retained no longer than required to deliver services and comply with legal obligations, after which it is securely deleted.

security.title: Security
security.text1: We apply modern technical and organisational measures to protect data against unauthorised access, loss or alteration.
security.text2: Confidential information is transmitted through secure encrypted channels.
security.text3: Access to data is restricted to authorised staff bound by confidentiality obligations.
security.text4: Despite all measures, absolute security on the internet cannot be guaranteed.

minors.title: Minors' data
minors.text1: Our services are not intended for independent use by persons under 16 years of age.
minors.text2: Information about minors is accepted only through their legal representatives.
minors.text3: If you become aware that a child's data has been shared without parental consent, please contact us — we will remove it promptly.
minors.text4: We process minors' data with particular care and strictly within the scope of necessary medical coordination.

updates.title: Policy updates
updates.text: We may update this Privacy Policy. The current version is always available on this page with the date of the latest update.

cookies.message: We use cookies to improve your experience on our website. By continuing to browse, you agree to our use of cookies.

services.question: What exactly does the Medical Concierge Agency do?
services.answer: We provide a full support cycle: expert document analysis, clinic selection, treatment coordination, translation of documentation, and full logistical support.

clinicSelection.question: Do you help choose a clinic or doctor in Germany?
clinicSelection.answer: Yes. Based on medical reports and the specifics of the request, we select specialized medical centers and highly specialized doctors with the necessary expertise.

travel.question: Do I need to already be in Germany to contact you?
travel.answer: No, the initial stage of work — document analysis and treatment plan formation — is carried out remotely before your arrival in Germany.

documents.question: Do you help with documents, translation, and communication with clinics?
documents.answer: Yes. We carry out professional translation of reports, structure the medical dossier according to the standards of German clinics, and ensure full communication with the attending physicians.

onSite.question: Is there on-site support and travel assistance?
onSite.answer: Yes. We provide Concierge service, organize transfers, provide medical interpreters for in-person consultations, and ensure coordination at all stages of the stay.

start.question: How to start working with you?
start.answer: Leave a request on the website. Our specialist will contact you for an initial analysis of the situation and determination of the further strategy.
